confidence_notes: The FX rate is the RBA AUD/USD figure for 2026-11-18, found by search and not read directly from the RBA page. Food and drink anchors come from three searches of aggregated, mostly crowd-sourced cost-of-living data (Numbeo via Expatica, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, Uhomes) and some venue menus. They give an inexpensive meal of about $20, a cappuccino of $5-6, a draft beer of about $7, and a mid-range dinner for two of about $80. I found no reliable local average for cocktails or wine by the glass. I set the cocktail at about $13 from the Expatistan estimate and a hotel menu, and the wine glass at about $11 from a hotel menu pour and the relationship to beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Tampa has few registered hostels, so the hostel and 1-star prices are especially uncertain. The 3-star price is an assumed typical level, and real prices vary a lot with events and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to mid-sized Sun Belt tourism cities such as Orlando, Jacksonville and New Orleans, with prices a little below Miami.
